{{Top|leg}}
'''Yreel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was considered to be a seedy, wannabe [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After missing his payments on the high-tech equipment he bought from an underworld kingpin, Yreel had his equipment repossessed and was also delivered to the kingpin along with his equipment.
